messages:
jordan.k: Quick heads-up — I'm about to hoist the `auth` submodule out of payments and split provider blocks. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4123
rachel: Thanks. Do we have a plan for the provider pin strategy? Last time lockfile drift caused staging failures. :eyes:
samir: Also: how are we going to move state for the `auth.oauth` resources? Any `terraform state mv` steps?
jordan.k: Good q's. Plan: pin providers at registry SHAs for k8s and google, regen lockfile once, then run staged canary apply to staging and canary namespace. I added a checklist in the PR.
liam: Suggestion: keep `required_providers` minimal and pin via `version = "= 3.4.1"` for the k8s provider and use a committed `.terraform.lock.hcl`. Command I ran locally:
```
terraform providers lock -platform=linux_amd64 -platform=linux_arm64
git add .terraform.lock.hcl && git commit -m "regen providers lock"
```
infra-bot: ci/status — plan succeeded on infra/pr-4123 (staging) :white_check_mark:
rachel: For k8s secret wiring, we need to keep the annotation `redwood.com/secret-path` unchanged. If the module split changes the resource addresses we should add an alias in the new module to avoid re-creating the secret.
samir: +1 on `alias` approach. For state move, steps in draft:
```
terraform state mv 'module.payments.module.auth.kubernetes_secret.aws' 'module.auth.kubernetes_secret.aws'
```
will need run with a lockfile from the post-regen plan.
ops-oncall: Will this affect production deploy cadence? Need rollback path if something re-creates secrets.
jordan.k: Won't touch prod until canary passes. Rollback plan: revert module tree and apply; providers lockfile is safe to revert as well. I'll tag ops before prod apply. Targeting staging canary tomorrow 09:30 PT.
liam: One more nit — add `prevent_destroy = true` on the secret resource in a temporary policy during the migration to ensure no accidental deletion.
rachel: Ack. I'll +1 the PR once the lockfile commit is in. Can someone run the `providers lock` command on CI so checksum matches the worker env?
infra-bot: ci/trigger — running `terraform providers lock` job on infra/locks with env matrix. ETA ~8m.
jordan.k: Thanks all, will push the lock commit in 20m and ping when CI finishes. :thumbsup:
